name: Star's★Peaces - Ren'ai Ouen ⇒ Tomodachi Kakutoku Keikaku
original_name: スターズ★ピース 恋愛応援⇒友達獲得ケーカク
source:
A high school adventure game with 30 high school student characters.
Main character "Hikari Kamikura" struggles at Heisei High School to break through the current situation where she has no friends!
